thread:
alana: Kicking off a leak-hunting sprint focused on KV cache residency + recent OOMs. We have the postmortem actions but no concrete owners/timelines yet — can we assign owners today and set a 2-week cadence for measurable checkpoints?

miguel: +1. Drop the postmortem link and the current action list so folks can pick. :thumbsup:

alana: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/kv-cache-oom-2026 — TL;DR: two likely contributors (fragmentation + sticky KV entries), need profiling, eviction hard/soft limits, and GC/alloc tuning.

devon: I can own deep-profiling (heap snapshots + kv residency traces). Goal: get baseline profiles from at least 5 problematic hosts by end of week.

oncall-bot: incident 2026-03-15-oom triggered on shard-gpu-17; stack excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T03:12:46Z OOM: alloc failed at arena.c:438
kv_residency_count=12M kv_total_bytes=48GB slab_free=2GB
```

oncall-bot: alerting history: 3 similar OOMs in last 30 days on this pool.

samir: I'll take GC tuning and eviction policy changes. Plan: propose a canary config with reduced sticky TTL + more aggressive softlimit (70% -> 60%) and test on staging. Timeline: config + smoke tests by Wed, canary next Tue.

alana: @samir please add a rollback plan in case GC scatter increases latency.

samir: noted. rollback: revert softlimit + re-enable previous slab settings, full runbook queued.

miguel: @devon for profiling, can you include the lightweight tracer we added last month? It gives per-request KV residency delta. Command to run locally: 
```
./scripts/kv_tracer --duration=300 --output=/tmp/kv-trace.json
```
Also capture /proc/meminfo and dmesg.

devon: yep. I'll also capture jemalloc stats and a pmap dump. Will upload artifacts to the postmortem doc.

tess: I'll own limit policy changes and the feature flag gating. I'll wire the FF to rollout at 10% then 50% if metrics look good. Need someone to own the observability checks (latency, tail-p99, OOM count).

miguel: I can add the alert rules to the Flint dashboard: p99 latency, OOM per shard, slab fragmentation ratio. Will create an alerts PR today.

alana: Ownership recap: devon=profiling (baseline by Fri), samir=GC/softlimit canary (config Wed, canary Tue), tess=FF rollout and eviction policy, miguel=alerts + dashboard. Deliverable checkpoint: 2-week sync on 1776616632 (two weeks out) with daily standups for the first 4 business days.

devon: putting short tasks in my backlog now. Will ping when first snapshots uploaded. :eyes:

samir: I'll draft the canary config in the infra repo and link it here.

alana: Quick tech note — try increasing slab compaction frequency and run a frag-scan during low traffic windows. Example snippet to run frag scan: 
```
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/frag-scan -d '{"shard":"shard-gpu-*","duration":600}'
```

miguel: adding runbook items: how to trigger frag-scan, how to revert FF, and sample heap/profile collection steps.

tess: scheduling the FF rollout windows: Tue 02:00-04:00 and Thu 02:00-04:00 PST, so we have minimal traffic.

alana: final ask — please add estimated risk (low/medium/high) to each action in the doc. If someone needs more runway, call it out now.

devon: risk for profiling = low. samir: risk for aggressive softlimit = medium (possible latency spike). tess: FF rollout risk = low if canary metrics stable.

alana: Great. I'll import this owner/timeline table into the postmortem and tag it as the "sprint kickoff" checkpoint. Thanks all. :rocket:
